issues: Cookie consent banner does NOT appear on static HTML homepage - only on React routes (/login, /admin, etc.). This is expected since CookieConsentBanner is a React component rendered outside BrowserRouter.

Trust badges component properly exported and used on policy pages and mandate apply page
